# Zelda

> Browser SNES player. The cartridge stays on the visitor's device.

This site does not host, mirror, or link to a game ROM.
You choose a .sfc file in the browser. Saves stay in that browser.

Controls: keyboard, standard gamepad, and on-screen buttons for mouse and touch.

Canonical: https://zelda.jonbailey.xyz/
Version: 1.0.0
